# Sweden

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Sveriges Riksbank

**Role:** Central bank and RIX-RTGS operator

**Reporting coverage:** Settlement account CAMT052/053/054 reporting plus request

**Messages / versions:** camt.052.001.08; camt.053.001.08; camt.054.001.08; camt.060.001.05; pacs

- [RIX-RTGS AnnexA1 Message Specifications](https://www.riksbank.se/globalassets/media/rix/rix-inst-rtgs/engelska/annex-a1-message-specifications.pdf) — specification; public-file
- [RIX-RTGS Instructions](https://www.riksbank.se/globalassets/media/rix/rix-inst-rtgs/engelska/rix-rtgs-instructions.pdf) — specification; public-file

Annex A1 table 1 lists CAMT052/053/054 v8 and CAMT060 v5. The public 59-page PDF includes simplified XML request examples; detailed usage guidelines are on Swift MyStandards. Scope is RIX account holders, not a universal corporate statement profile.
